name: Terraform Apply

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [dev, test, staging, main]
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  apply:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.pull_request.merged == true &&
      (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'dev' ||
       github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'test' ||
       github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'staging' ||
       github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main')
    strategy:
      matrix:
        # NOTE: k8s_cluster deploys cluster only, node pools excluded from pipeline
        module: [networking, k8s_cluster, database, ocir, load_balancer, dns, vault, iam, waf, monitoring]
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.5.0
      

      - name: Set Environment
        id: set-env
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}" == "dev" ]]; then
            echo "environment=dev" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}" == "test" ]]; then
            echo "environment=test" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}" == "staging" ]]; then
            echo "environment=staging" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}" == "main" ]]; then
            echo "environment=prod" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Install and Configure OCI CLI
        if: steps.set-env.outputs.environment == 'dev'
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          # Install OCI CLI using pip (faster than script)
          pip3 install oci-cli
          
          # Configure OCI CLI
          mkdir -p ~/.oci
          cat > ~/.oci/config << EOF
          [DEFAULT]
          user=${{ secrets.OCI_USER_OCID }}
          fingerprint=${{ secrets.OCI_FINGERPRINT }}
          tenancy=${{ secrets.OCI_TENANCY_OCID }}
          region=${{ secrets.OCI_REGION }}
          key_file=~/.oci/oci_api_key.pem
          EOF
          echo "${{ secrets.OCI_PRIVATE_KEY }}" > ~/.oci/oci_api_key.pem
          chmod 600 ~/.oci/oci_api_key.pem
          chmod 600 ~/.oci/config
      
      - name: Bootstrap Resources Check (Dev Only)
        if: steps.set-env.outputs.environment == 'dev'
        id: bootstrap-check
        timeout-minutes: 30
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          echo "🔍 Checking bootstrap resources for dev environment..."
          
          # Check if compartment exists
          if ! oci iam compartment get --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "❌ Compartment not found: ${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}"
            echo "bootstrap_needed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ Compartment exists"
          
          # Check if availability domain exists
          if ! oci iam availability-domain list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_TENANCY_OCID }}" --query "data[?name=='${{ secrets.OCI_AVAILABILITY_DOMAIN }}']" | grep -q "${{ secrets.OCI_AVAILABILITY_DOMAIN }}"; then
            echo "❌ Availability domain not found: ${{ secrets.OCI_AVAILABILITY_DOMAIN }}"
            echo "bootstrap_needed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ Availability domain exists"
          
          echo "bootstrap_needed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "🎉 All bootstrap resources verified for dev environment"
      
      - name: Apply Bootstrap (If Needed)
        if: steps.set-env.outputs.environment == 'dev' && steps.bootstrap-check.outputs.bootstrap_needed == 'true'
        working-directory: environments/oci/bootstrap
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Applying bootstrap resources..."
          
          # Replace tokens in bootstrap terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__TENANCY_OCID__|${{ secrets.OCI_TENANCY_OCID }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__USER_OCID__|${{ secrets.OCI_USER_OCID }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__FINGERPRINT__|${{ secrets.OCI_FINGERPRINT }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__COMPARTMENT_ID__|${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          
          # Replace private key
          cat > terraform.tfvars.tmp << 'EOF'
          ${{ secrets.OCI_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          EOF
          awk '/__PRIVATE_KEY__/ { print "private_key = <<EOK"; while ((getline line < "terraform.tfvars.tmp") > 0) { print line } print "EOK"; close("terraform.tfvars.tmp"); next } { print }' terraform.tfvars > terraform.tfvars.new
          mv terraform.tfvars.new terraform.tfvars
          rm -f terraform.tfvars.tmp
          
          terraform init -no-color
          terraform apply -input=false -no-color -auto-approve
      
      - name: Replace Tokens with Secrets
        working-directory: environments/oci/${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }}
        run: |
          # Replace simple tokens with actual secret values
          sed -i 's|__TENANCY_OCID__|${{ secrets.OCI_TENANCY_OCID }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__USER_OCID__|${{ secrets.OCI_USER_OCID }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__FINGERPRINT__|${{ secrets.OCI_FINGERPRINT }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__COMPARTMENT_ID__|${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          sed -i 's|__DB_ADMIN_PASSWORD__|${{ secrets.DB_ADMIN_PASSWORD }}|g' terraform.tfvars
          
          # Replace private key token with heredoc format
          cat > terraform.tfvars.tmp << 'EOF'
          ${{ secrets.OCI_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          EOF
          
          # Replace __PRIVATE_KEY__ with the actual key content
          awk '
          /__PRIVATE_KEY__/ {
            print "private_key = <<EOK"
            while ((getline line < "terraform.tfvars.tmp") > 0) {
              print line
            }
            print "EOK"
            close("terraform.tfvars.tmp")
            next
          }
          { print }
          ' terraform.tfvars > terraform.tfvars.new
          
          mv terraform.tfvars.new terraform.tfvars
          rm -f terraform.tfvars.tmp
      
      - name: Terraform Init
        working-directory: environments/oci/${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }}
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Initializing Terraform for ${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }} environment..."
          terraform init -no-color
      
      - name: Check Module Resources Exist
        # CRITICAL: Verifies if resources exist in Terraform State and OCI before attempting creation
        # Prevents fatal "resource already exists" errors and enables idempotent pipeline execution
        # Flow: Check State → If missing, check OCI → If exists in OCI, mark for import → Else create new
        # Importance: Avoids duplicates, optimizes time, enables drift detection, ensures pipeline reliability
        id: check-resources
        working-directory: environments/oci/${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }}
        timeout-minutes: 5
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          echo "🔍 Checking if ${{ matrix.module }} resources already exist..."
          
          # Check terraform state first for all modules
          if terraform state list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "module.${{ matrix.module }}"; then
            echo "✅ ${{ matrix.module }} already in terraform state"
            echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }}" == "dev" ]]; then
            # Check if resources exist in OCI but not in terraform state
            case "${{ matrix.module }}" in
              "networking")
                VCN_NAME=$(grep '^vcn_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$VCN_NAME" ]] && oci network vcn list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --display-name "$VCN_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$VCN_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "k8s_cluster")
                CLUSTER_NAME=$(grep '^cluster_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$CLUSTER_NAME" ]] && oci ce cluster list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --name "$CLUSTER_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$CLUSTER_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "database")
                DB_NAME=$(grep '^db_system_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$DB_NAME" ]] && oci db autonomous-database list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --display-name "$DB_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$DB_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "load_balancer")
                LB_NAME=$(grep '^lb_display_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$LB_NAME" ]] && oci lb load-balancer list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --display-name "$LB_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$LB_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "ocir")
                REPO_NAME=$(grep '^ocir_repository_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$REPO_NAME" ]] && oci artifacts container repository list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --display-name "$REPO_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$REPO_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "dns")
                DNS_ZONE=$(grep '^dns_zone_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$DNS_ZONE" ]] && oci dns zone list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --name "$DNS_ZONE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$DNS_ZONE"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "vault")
                VAULT_NAME=$(grep '^vault_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$VAULT_NAME" ]] && oci kms vault list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --display-name "$VAULT_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$VAULT_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "waf")
                WAF_NAME=$(grep '^waf_policy_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$WAF_NAME" ]] && oci waas waas-policy list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --display-name "$WAF_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$WAF_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "iam")
                IAM_NAME=$(grep '^iam_policy_name' terraform.tfvars | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "' || echo "")
                if [[ -n "$IAM_NAME" ]] && oci iam policy list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --name "$IAM_NAME" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$IAM_NAME"; then
                  echo "skip_apply=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                else
                  echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                fi
                ;;
              "monitoring")
                echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                ;;
              *)
                echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                ;;
            esac
          else
            # For non-dev environments, proceed with apply if not in state
            echo "skip_apply=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "needs_import=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
      
      - name: Import Existing Resources
        # CRITICAL: Brings existing OCI resources under Terraform management when they exist physically but not in state
        # Synchronizes Terraform state with OCI reality to prevent creation conflicts and maintain control
        # Enables adoption of manually created resources and recovery from state file loss
        # Importance: Prevents duplicate creation errors, maintains infrastructure continuity, enables disaster recovery
        if: steps.check-resources.outputs.needs_import == 'true'
        working-directory: environments/oci/${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          echo "📥 Importing existing ${{ matrix.module }} resources into terraform state..."
          
          case "${{ matrix.module }}" in
            "networking")
              VCN_OCID=$(oci network vcn list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --query "data[?contains(\"display-name\", 'dev-vcn')].id | [0]" --raw-output 2>/dev/null)
              if [[ -n "$VCN_OCID" && "$VCN_OCID" != "null" ]]; then
                echo "Found VCN OCID: $VCN_OCID"
                terraform import module.networking.oci_core_vcn.vcn "$VCN_OCID"
              fi
              ;;
            "k8s_cluster")
              CLUSTER_OCID=$(oci ce cluster list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --query "data[?contains(\"name\", 'dev-oke')].id | [0]" --raw-output 2>/dev/null)
              if [[ -n "$CLUSTER_OCID" && "$CLUSTER_OCID" != "null" ]]; then
                echo "Found OKE cluster OCID: $CLUSTER_OCID"
                terraform import module.k8s_cluster.oci_containerengine_cluster.oke "$CLUSTER_OCID"
              fi
              ;;
            "database")
              DB_OCID=$(oci db autonomous-database list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --query "data[?contains(\"display-name\", 'addonaidevdbash2')].id | [0]" --raw-output 2>/dev/null)
              if [[ -n "$DB_OCID" && "$DB_OCID" != "null" ]]; then
                echo "Found database OCID: $DB_OCID"
                terraform import module.database.oci_database_autonomous_database.postgres "$DB_OCID"
              fi
              ;;
            "load_balancer")
              LB_OCID=$(oci lb load-balancer list --compartment-id "${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID }}" --query "data[?contains(\"display-name\", 'dev-lb')].id | [0]" --raw-output 2>/dev/null)
              if [[ -n "$LB_OCID" && "$LB_OCID" != "null" ]]; then
                echo "Found load balancer OCID: $LB_OCID"
                terraform import module.load_balancer.oci_load_balancer_load_balancer.lb "$LB_OCID"
              fi
              ;;
            *)
              echo "No import logic defined for ${{ matrix.module }}"
              ;;
          esac
      
      - name: Terraform Apply Module
        if: steps.check-resources.outputs.skip_apply != 'true'
        working-directory: environments/oci/${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }}
        timeout-minutes: 25
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Applying ${{ matrix.module }} module for ${{ steps.set-env.outputs.environment }} environment..."
          terraform apply -target=module.${{ matrix.module }} -input=false -no-color -auto-approve
      
      - name: Skip Apply (Resources Exist)
        if: steps.check-resources.outputs.skip_apply == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "⏭️ Skipping ${{ matrix.module }} - resources already exist"
